decisions.statement: A transaction is the six fields a rule can weigh rather than the whole of Monarch's row.
A description is the merchant and the statement line joined in that order.
An amount is compared in cents.
Two sums a hundredth apart are two sums.
An amount written out carries its sign and two places after the point.
A day gap is whole days from midnight UTC rather than elapsed time.
A date that cannot be parsed is refused rather than measured as nothing.
An account is known by the last four digits its title ends in.
An account whose title ends in no four digits is known by its lowered title.
A category of Uncategorized is no answer.
The trusted window is twelve months and the unattended window is seven days.
A window is cut from a moment handed in rather than from the clock.
Nothing here reads a file or reaches Monarch.

definition: what every reader of a Monarch row agrees a transaction is, and the windows judged against it
